_comment: DLG / LuxuryIQ relevance model for Techmeme headlines. Edit weights and keywords to tune. A headline's score is the sum of the weights of every theme it matches; matching a theme also attaches that theme's DLG angle and suggestion seed. Keywords are matched case-insensitively as whole-ish tokens against the headline + summary text.

themes.label: AI / generative models / agents
themes.dlg_angle: LuxuryIQ ships as an MCP server and DLG advises brands on where genAI touches the customer journey; capability and platform shifts here change what we can build and sell.
themes.idea: Assess whether this changes the LuxuryIQ MCP roadmap or gives a concrete talking point for the next brand AI-readiness conversation.

themes.label: Search / answer engines / GEO
themes.dlg_angle: DLG runs GEO audits; anything reshaping how answer engines surface brands directly affects client visibility and our audit methodology.
themes.idea: Flag for the GEO practice: does this shift the audit checklist, or is it a proof point to bring to clients worried about AI search visibility?

themes.label: Social & content platforms
themes.dlg_angle: These are the paid and organic channels DLG plans and buys for luxury clients; feature, algorithm, and policy changes move media strategy and creator work.
themes.idea: Note any channel-planning or creator-strategy implication for current retainers; check if a client brief needs updating.

themes.label: E-commerce, resale & commerce tech
themes.dlg_angle: LuxuryIQ tracks the luxury secondary market and pricing; commerce-platform and resale moves are direct signal for the product and for client retail strategy.
themes.idea: Check whether this is a data point LuxuryIQ should ingest or a resale-market trend worth a client note.

themes.label: Adtech, measurement & privacy
themes.dlg_angle: DLG plans and measures paid media; targeting, measurement, and regulation shifts change campaign design and what we can promise on attribution.
themes.idea: Assess impact on media measurement and targeting for luxury campaigns; is a client heads-up warranted?

themes.label: Named luxury / premium brands & groups
themes.dlg_angle: A named client or peer brand in the tech news cycle is the highest-signal item we can surface, whether it is opportunity, competitive move, or risk.
themes.idea: Determine if this is a live client, a prospect, or a competitor, and whether it warrants an immediate internal flag.

themes.label: China / APAC tech & commerce
themes.dlg_angle: APAC, and China specifically, is decisive for luxury demand; platform and macro-tech shifts there feed both client strategy and LuxuryIQ demand signals.
themes.idea: Note any APAC demand or channel implication for luxury clients with China exposure.

themes.label: Immersive / spatial / AR
themes.dlg_angle: Immersive formats surface periodically in luxury brand experience work; worth tracking as an experiential channel, lower priority than core themes.
themes.idea: Park as a watch-item unless a luxury use case is explicit.
